thread:
Tara Chen: Quick sync — we need to lock the API failure contract for launch across chat / embeddings / rerank / tool-calls. Main asks: canonical status codes, retry hints, special cases for function/tool calling, and structured-output validation behavior. Customers want a single doc SDKs can rely on.

Sanjay Patel: +1. Proposal from infra: keep HTTP semantics but add stable error payload with fields: `code`, `message`, `error_class`, `retryable`, `retry_after_seconds` (if applicable). Example: `{\"code\":\"rate_limit\",\"message\":\"quota exceeded\",\"error_class\":\"rate_limit\",\"retryable\":true,\"retry_after_seconds\":30}`.

Eva Morales: For status codes mapping, I suggest: 400 -> validation (invalid prompt / body), 401 -> auth, 403 -> forbidden, 404 -> not_found, 409 -> conflict (model version mismatch), 422 -> schema_error (structured-output validation), 429 -> rate_limit, 503 -> model_unavailable (transient), 500/502/504 -> infra/backend. Keep 5xx for server unrecoverable unless we set `retryable`.

Mike Liu: For tool/function calling we faced two classes: (A) tool execution failure (e.g., HTTP 5xx from 3rd party) and (B) model failed to produce a valid function call. For (A) return 424 (failed dependency) with `error_class":\"tool_error\"` and include `tool_name` in payload. For (B) return 422 with `error_class":\"function_schema\"`.

Tara Chen: Good distinction. Also customers asked for deterministic client guidance. We should publish explicit SDK heuristics: retry on 429 (respect Retry-After), retry on 503 with exponential backoff up to N attempts, do NOT retry on 400/422/401/403/409.

Sanjay Patel: Agree. Add a clear rule: `retryable = true` overrides HTTP class for SDKs (e.g., we may mark a 500 as retryable during transient model fallback). SDK must consult `retryable` and `retry_after_seconds`.

Eva Morales: For structured output (JSON schema) failures: we return 422 with body: `{\"code\":\"schema_invalid\",\"message\":\"output did not match schema\",\"error_class\":\"schema_invalid\",\"details\":[\"path:$.choices[0].text\"]}`. This avoids forcing clients to parse freeform 400s.

Mike Liu: Rerank: heavy CPU—if we can't serve due to capacity return 429 with `error_class":\"capacity_limit\"` and provide a `quota_scope` (project/org). Prefer that over 503 so clients know to throttle per-key.

Tara Chen: Launch gates checklist (short):
- SDKs updated to honor `retryable` + `retry_after_seconds` (owner: Mike, due: +2w)
- Docs: error contract doc + examples for each endpoint (owner: Eva, due: +1w)
- E2E tests: simulate failures for chat/embeds/rerank/tools (owner: Sanjay, due: +2w)
- Backwards-compat note: stable field names for 90 days after launch or we provide opt-in header to opt-in to new contract.

Sanjay Patel: Prioritization for implementation: 1) canonical payload + 429/503/400 mappings for chat+embeds 2) structured-output 422 for functions/structured-chat 3) tool-specific 424 payload 4) per-project quota metadata and `quota_scope`. Estimate: 3 sprints.

Eva Morales: Customer asks we negotiated: some enterprise customers want `error_code` numeric for SIEM ingestion. We'll expose `error_code_int` (stable mapping) but keep `code` (string) as primary. Document mapping table.

Mike Liu: Small SDK detail: when `retry_after_seconds` is missing but `retryable=true`, SDKs should use exponential backoff starting at 1s. When `retry_after_seconds` present, honor it strictly.

Tara Chen: Decision summary:
- Use HTTP + stable JSON payload with `code, message, error_class, retryable, retry_after_seconds, details`
- Map 422 -> schema/structured failures, 424 -> tool dependency failures, 429 -> rate/capacity, 503 -> model_unavailable (transient), 4xx -> client validation/authz.
- SDKs must consult `retryable` and `retry_after_seconds`; docs will include canonical retry loops.
- Launch order: chat/embeds -> structured-output -> rerank -> tool-edge cases.

Eva Morales: Quick wording for docs: "Clients MUST NOT retry on error_class in {validation, auth, permission, schema_invalid} and SHOULD retry on {rate_limit, model_unavailable, backend_transient} with backoff and limits."

Sanjay Patel: Action items added to product board. Also: add a small contract test in CI that validates payload fields for each error type.

ProductWGBot: Note: meeting summary created and linked to board-123 (https://rwd/board-123).

Mike Liu: One more nuance: streaming responses (chat streaming). If model dies mid-stream, we should send a terminal event with `event_type":\"error_chunk\"` and the same contract fields. SDKs should surface it as an error rather than partial success.

Tara Chen: Great. Final ask: legal/security wants a short SLA paragraph for model_unavailable fallback behavior. I'll loop them in. If no objections by EOD we freeze the contract and start docs + SDK work. :thumbsup:

Eva Morales: No objections.

Sanjay Patel: No objections.

Mike Liu: No objections.

Tara Chen: Locking this thread. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
